inclusionRules: Included: BodyParts3D concepts whose English name is a named ligament, plus interosseous membranes (syndesmoses) and flexor retinacula (deep fibrous / ligamentous layer). Excluded: calcaneal (Achilles) tendons, extraocular check ligaments, lens suspensory ligaments, trochleae, abstract parents, arteries. Major joint ligaments absent from BodyParts3D 4.0 (ACL/PCL, collaterals, hip capsular ligaments, glenohumeral, annular, ATFL/CFL/PTFL, spinal ALL/PLL/flavum) are synthesized as landmark-anchored bands (source=synthetic) — educational approximations, not cadaver segmentations.
syntheticDisclaimer: Entries with source=synthetic are educational approximations placed between named landmarks (or X-mirrored contralateral landmarks). They are not segmented from cadaver imaging and must not be treated as morphologically accurate.
